verdict.rationale: OneDrive documents a REST file API through Microsoft Graph. The pack covers single-call upload up to 250 MB, resumable upload sessions, addressing items by ID or path, search across the hierarchy, and delta tracking, plus a published $metadata CSDL and Graph Explorer for testing. However, the pack only partly evidences the full CRUD set the story names. missing for 10: documented download-content endpoint, list-children endpoint, move (PATCH parentReference) endpoint, delete endpoint, independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic file operations.

support.subject: As a developer, files move through a real API — upload, download, list, move, and delete over documented REST endpoints, not just a desktop client

citations.quote: You can use Microsoft Graph to create an app that connects with files across OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, and SharePoint document libraries
Provide the contents of a new file or update the contents of an existing file in a single API call. This method only supports files up to 250 MB in size.
An upload session allows your app to upload ranges of the file in sequential API requests. It also enables the transfer to resume if the connection is dropped during the upload.
By the driveItem unique identifier using drive/items/{item-id} By file system path using /drive/root:/path/to/file
Search the hierarchy of items for items matching a query. You can search within a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the current user.
